subject: prd/docgate
statement: When a checked revision is supplied, `check-projection-congruence` shall read the complete ledger prefix from that exact revision; when none is supplied, it shall read the working tree through the ordinary ledger reader and produce the same verdict for the same bytes.
rationale: another session's dirty shared worktree must not alter the verdict for the revision being pushed, and the merge-target path must not become a twin predicate
fit_criterion: head-set and head-empty conformance fixtures produce identical defects for identical trees; a dirty worktree mutation cannot alter the head-set verdict
